original.quote: Save as set out in this Clause 5, the total aggregate liability of each party under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

redline.proposed_text: The total aggregate liability of each party under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Buyer to the Supplier in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
redline.rationale: Updated to meet the LIABILITY-001 fallback position regarding annual fees specification.

original.quote: The Supplier's obligations under this Clause 12 shall not be subject to any limitation of liability, and the cap set out in Clause 5 shall not apply to this Clause 12.

redline.proposed_text: The Supplier's indemnification obligations under this Clause shall be subject to a separate aggregate cap not exceeding two (2) times the annual fees, save that indemnities for intellectual property infringement and data breach shall remain uncapped.
redline.rationale: Replaced uncapped general indemnity with a separate cap per LIABILITY-002 fallback.

original.quote: Neither party may terminate this Agreement for convenience.

redline.proposed_text: The Buyer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time on sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the Supplier.
redline.rationale: Added buyer termination for convenience per TERMINATION-001 fallback.

original.quote: Service credits of 3% of the monthly fee apply for each percentage point below a 96% on-time target, capped at 20% of the monthly fee.

redline.proposed_text: ESCALATE: Fallback requires measurable uptime of at least 99.9%, which contradicts the core contract terms.
redline.rationale: Cannot meet the SLA-001 fallback text directly without altering the underlying uptime metrics significantly.

original.quote: The Supplier may increase the Charges at its sole discretion upon thirty (30) days' written notice to the Buyer.

redline.proposed_text: Fees are fixed for the initial term. Any increase on renewal shall not exceed the lower of CPI or five percent (5%) per annum.
redline.rationale: Replaced unilateral price increases with price protection per PRICE-001 fallback.
